standard_prerequisites.name: The affine open covering of the blowup by the spectra of the affine blowup algebras A[I/a_i]
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 4651-4655 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement about sheaves on the blowup to statements about the affine blowup algebras.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the derived pullback of the quasi-coherent module on the affine pieces, and the annihilation statement for the affine blowup algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The derived pullback description is a cross-chapter pointer (source lines 4656-4658), and the annihilation for the affine case is the author lemma lemma-annihilates-affine, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 4554-4560)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the required annihilation of the cohomology sheaves into the annihilation of the Tor modules of the affine blowup algebras.

core_obligations: Reduce to a covering: the question being affine local on the blowup, the proof uses the covering of the blowup by the spectra of the affine blowup algebras of the chosen generators of the ideal (proof lines 4651-4655)

Translate to Tor: by the description of the derived pullback on an affine chart, it suffices to produce a power of the ideal annihilating the Tor modules of the affine blowup algebra in degrees above the number of generators (proof lines 4656-4663)
Invoke the affine statement: this is exactly the annihilation statement for the affine blowup algebra, whose statement is included as a context span (proof lines 4664-4665)
proof_roadmap: 设 I = (a_1,…,a_t)，用仿射开覆盖 X = ⋃ Spec(A[I/a_i])（跨章引理），于是问题化为逐卡片的断言。
由跨章的导出拉回描述，只需对每个 i 找 c ≥ 0 使 Tor_j^A(A[I/a_i], M) 在 j ≥ t 时被 I^c 零化——这正是 lemma-annihilates-affine。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a power of the ideal, depending only on the ideal, that annihilates all the cohomology sheaves of the derived pullback of any module to the blowup, in degrees below the negative of the number of generators (author lemma at source lines 4642-4648, label lemma-annihilates). The proof (source lines 4650-4666) reduces the statement to an affine local computation on the standard covering of the blowup by the spectra of the affine blowup algebras, translates the required annihilation into the annihilation of the Tor modules of those algebras using the description of the derived pullback, and then quotes the affine statement, which is reproduced as a context span (proof lines 4651-4665). The reduction through the standard covering and the translation to Tor are the content. H2.
